inventory.name: Half-Eaten Corpse-Starch Ration
inventory.description: Tastes like pressed sawdust and salt; keeps starvation at bay for one more shift.

decisions.decision: Patrolled the lower ventilation intake of Hab-Block Vermis-9 and reported leaking sulfur pipes.
decisions.impact: Alerted the garrison to toxic gas buildup before morning shift began.

decisions.decision: Hauled newly delivered plasteel slabs into position alongside Bragg as the welding torches ignited.
decisions.impact: Morale rallied seeing command deliver promised supplies to the frontline.

decisions.decision: Locked down the secondary sandbag redoubt and zeroed the heavy stubber crossfire arc across the sealed gate.
Fought side-by-side with Sergeant Vane, hurling two frag canisters into the lower drainage throat to seal the breach forever.
decisions.impact: Conscript transformed from reluctant survivor into battle-hardened squad veteran.

decisions.decision: Guided the Sergeant through the sludge shoals and sniffed out an abandoned Munitorum locker containing 4 heavy stubber belts and 3 brass valves.
decisions.impact: Boosted garrison heavy ammo reserves and located the predator's toxic slime trail.

decisions.decision: Blasted backward into the catwalk railings by the beast's tail-lash, screaming as two conscripts beside him were dissolved into slurry.
decisions.impact: Pinned under iron girders, lasgun power cell sparking in the mud.

decisions.decision: Blasted backward into the catwalk railings by the beast's tail-lash, screaming as two conscripts beside him were dissolved into slurry.
decisions.impact: Pinned under iron girders, lasgun power cell sparking in the mud.

decisions.decision: Crawled out from beneath the collapsed iron girders with blood running down his face, dragging a severed battery pack to fire continuous las-bursts into the beast's sensory cluster.
decisions.impact: Temporarily blinded the beast's forward ocular lobes, allowing Vane to close the distance; Jax took shrapnel from wild flailing (Vitality 40 -> 30).

decisions.decision: Joined the final bayonet surge chanting the Emperor's name through tears and blood; jammed an emergency stim-injector into his neck and pinned the fallen Matriarch's eye with his lasgun barrel.
decisions.impact: Stabilized by emergency stim-injector (Vitality 5 -> 30); transformed from terrified sump-scum into an unshakable veteran survivor.

decisions.decision: Pried open the gullet of the beast with gaff-hooks, discovering the intact equipment lockers and web gear of a swallowed Munitorum forward patrol.
decisions.impact: Recovered 30 lasgun battery packs, 4 heavy stubber belts, and 2 autocannon boxes for the armory.

decisions.decision: Rallied 4 veteran conscripts, fitted with grade-3 respirators, and moved ahead to mark safe footing across the crumbling ancient plasteel bridges.
decisions.impact: Discovered an unlooted pre-Heresy maintenance conduit leading into the central cogitator spire; vitality recovered to 55.

decisions.decision: Used his sump-scout optical auspex to map the power cabling connecting the archeotech generator to the vault blast locks, reporting back to Vane with precise schematic sketches.
decisions.impact: Identified the override manual breaker, allowing the squad to bypass the lethal security grid.

decisions.decision: Assisted the Sarge with the datasmith override wafer, then broke the seal on Armory 00-Null; claimed a gleaming Mark IV Plasma Gun, beaming with pride as a consecrated vanguard gunner.
decisions.impact: Armed with archeotech plasma weaponry; transformed into an elite heavy marksman with zero fear of future mutant swarms.

decisions.decision: Took up overwatch position at the Basilica entrance with his newly acquired Mark IV Plasma Gun, coordinating with the vanguard to ensure no stragglers breached the holy perimeter.
decisions.impact: Maintained an iron perimeter around the resting command staff.

decisions.impact: Maintained an iron perimeter around the resting command staff.

decisions.decision: Emptied overcharged sun-fire salvos from his Mark IV Plasma Gun into Malgakor's daemonic energy conduits, vaporizing heretical runes before being blown backward by the warp-backlash.
decisions.impact: Inflicted nearly 1,500 damage to the outer shield; took caustic warp burns (Vitality 65 -> 54).

decisions.decision: Gasping as the stim hit his bloodstream, braced his Mark IV Plasma Gun against the Kastelan's foot and delivered a maximum-power bolt into Malgakor's breastplate, blowing a smoking crater into the daemonic armor.
decisions.impact: Stabilized from death threshold (Vitality 5 -> 30); delivered over 1,400 plasma damage.

decisions.decision: Overcharged his Mark IV Plasma Gun to maximum reactor overload, shoving the glowing barrel into Malgakor's faceplate and pulling the trigger in a blinding sun-fire blast.
decisions.impact: Fell in glorious combat (Vitality 5 -> 0, KIA), vaporizing Malgakor's helmet and blinding the Chaos God.

decisions.decision: Clutched chest and gasped for air as mortal wounds sealed cleanly; stood and chambered a power pack into his lasgun with renewed determination.
decisions.impact: Restored to operational duty beside his sergeant.
